body.name: Sharp initial-absorption frontier pair
body.construction: Mix \(4/5\) of \(\omega^\star\) with an all-exit path of probability \(1/5\) in each cohort.  In \(P^A\), assign the added all-exit mass to type \(1\); in \(P^B\), assign it to type \(2\).  Leave every type-specific transition kernel and the latent labels of the \(\omega^\star\) component fixed.  This construction names the observational-equivalence pair; its identified and unidentified quantities are established by \(\texttt{prop:exact-boundary-witness}\), not by definition.
